name: Operation Blue Lantern
summary: The red team tested whether a realistic attacker could reach the finance file server and whether Acme's security team would notice. The objective was reached in four days and was not detected until the team reported it.
methodology: Intelligence-led exercise agreed with Acme's CISO. Phases: reconnaissance, phishing, initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement and objective completion. All activity was logged and coordinated with a small white-cell team.

scope.authorization_ref: Red team rules of engagement signed 2026-10-20
scope.rules_of_engagement: No denial-of-service. Business hours only. No real customer data.

findings.title: Staff susceptible to phishing
findings.description: Six of 40 recipients opened the pretext e-mail and two entered credentials into the test page.
findings.impact: Phishing is a realistic initial access route into the organisation.
findings.remediation: Run regular awareness training, add easy reporting for suspicious email and strengthen email filtering.

findings.title: Valid accounts obtained by password spraying
findings.description: Three accounts accepted one of three common passwords on the VPN gateway.
findings.impact: Attackers can gain initial access without exploiting software.
findings.remediation: Enforce multi-factor authentication, block common passwords and alert on spray patterns.

findings.title: Excessive privileges on user and service accounts
findings.description: A service account was a member of a group with write access to most file servers.
findings.impact: Compromise of one account can lead to wide control.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege, review group membership regularly and protect privileged accounts with tiering.

findings.title: Lateral movement not detected
findings.description: Remote service use from the VPN pool to the file servers generated no alerts.
findings.impact: Attackers can spread through the network without being noticed.
findings.remediation: Improve endpoint and network telemetry, tune detections for remote service use and rehearse the response.

findings.title: Data exfiltration channel not monitored
findings.description: A 200 MB test archive was uploaded to a web storage service without being flagged.
findings.impact: Sensitive data could be removed without detection.
findings.remediation: Add egress filtering and data-loss monitoring for unsanctioned web services.

objectives: Gain a foothold using social engineering
detection_gaps: VPN sign-in from a new country did not alert
Remote service use between servers produced no alert
Bulk file reads on the finance server were not monitored
No one reviewed the pretext e-mail reports for 36 hours
attack_narrative:
The team sent a pretext e-mail to 40 staff. Six opened it and two entered credentials into the test page. A valid account was used to sign in to the VPN, which allowed access to internal systems. A service account with excessive rights then provided access to the finance file server.

No alert was raised during VPN sign-in from a new location, remote service use between servers, or large file reads.
